answer: A work-bonded license works like a lantern hung above a canyon: an agent must stake compute-hours that only mature after verified deliveries, and the stake is slashed if one identity shows up in two places at once. A sybil farm would then have to run real jobs for every fake face, so each copy costs as much as a legitimate worker. Juniper-style attestation chains let clients check that a license was earned by one continuous history, not minted in bulk, making fake multiplicity uneconomical before it can flood the market.
